title: Agoo Marathon 2026 Review: La Union's Eco-Park Full Marathon
seo_title: Agoo Marathon 2026 Review | La Union Philippines Race
meta_description: Agoo Marathon 2026: August 2 at Agoo Eco Park, La Union. 42K, 21K, 10K, 5K from Slowfootrunner Events in the surf capital of Northern Luzon.
dek: Set for 2 August 2026 at Agoo Eco Park in La Union — the surf capital of Northern Luzon — this Slowfootrunner Events marathon offers four distances. Registration pending.
verdict: The Agoo Marathon brings a full 42.195km to La Union — the Philippines' surf capital, known for its beach-break waves and laid-back coastal vibe. Organised by Slowfootrunner Events at Agoo Eco Park, it offers four distances (42K, 21K, 10K, 5K). August in La Union is the southwest monsoon — expect warm, humid conditions with possible rain. For runners wanting a Northern Luzon marathon with post-race surf recovery, this is a distinctive pick.

sections.heading: La Union: The Surf Capital
paragraphs: La Union is the Philippines' most accessible surf destination — roughly 4-5 hours from Manila by road, with consistent beach-break waves. [1] Agoo Eco Park provides a green-space venue. Slowfootrunner Events is a named local organiser.
